title: Store Manager
summary: Lead a flagship retail location, build a high-performing team and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
responsibilities: Own daily store operations and performance
Coach and develop the retail team
Drive customer experience and commercial outcomes
requirements: Strong people leadership and planning skills
Comfort working with targets and business reporting

title: Financial Analyst
summary: Turn financial and operational data into clear recommendations for teams across the business.
responsibilities: Partner with operating teams on business cases
requirements: Degree in finance, accounting or a related field

title: Human Resources Executive
summary: Support recruitment, employee engagement and dependable people operations across a growing organisation.
responsibilities: Support engagement and HR operations programmes
requirements: Working knowledge of HR systems and processes

title: E-commerce Category Lead
summary: Own category growth across digital channels through strong merchandising, trading and partner management.
responsibilities: Build category growth and trading plans
Use customer data to improve conversion

title: Visual Merchandiser
summary: Create compelling in-store experiences that bring product stories and seasonal campaigns to life.
responsibilities: Partner with store teams on execution
requirements: Strong eye for detail and presentation
Ability to travel across assigned locations
